# ElectroMart

> ElectroMart is an electronics e-commerce store offering laptops, desktops, printers, PC components (CPU, GPU, RAM, motherboard, power supply, cabinet), peripherals, and more with fast delivery across India, GST invoicing, and B2B bulk sourcing.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://electromart.in/): Storefront with featured deals, top-rated and recommended products.
- [All Products](https://electromart.in/products.html): Browse the full electronics catalog with filters.
- [Laptops](https://electromart.in/laptop.html): Work, gaming, and creator-ready laptops.
- [Computers / Desktops](https://electromart.in/desktops.html): Performance desktop builds.
- [Printers](https://electromart.in/printer.html): Home and office printers.
- [PC Builder](https://electromart.in/pc-builder.html): Custom PC configuration tool.
- [Today's Deals](https://electromart.in/todays-deals.html): Limited-time discounts and offers.
- [Best Sellers](https://electromart.in/best-sellers.html): Most-purchased products now.
- [Brands](https://electromart.in/brands.html): Shop by brand.
- [Creator Studio](https://electromart.in/creator-studio.html): Creator-focused setups and gear.
- [Mega Store](https://electromart.in/mega-store.html): Extended store catalog.
